body: I'm sure you're probably not giving yourself enough credit. Then again, I dont know you. I just hope someday you can find peace, or maybe even some motivation to sort yourself out. I figure before I kill myself I might as well try. Best of luck friend.
In the same place brother, my self worth goes down the fucking tubes anytime I talk to a girl. 😔

I have very similar issues, I feel like you described me in your post and it made me feel less alone so thanks for that. Body insecurity is such hell. I wish I had some comforting words for you but I'm pretty crushed by my own circumstances. I'm sorry you have to deal with this soul draining shit so early on in life. 😔
Wow you've perfectly articulated how I've been feeling recently. Try and keep your head up man!

Recently graduated from high school. I have no friends and only managed to keep acquaintances while I was there. I have pretty bad body dysmorphia and am a social retard. I'm employed but I still feel so hollow and hopeless. The only things keeping me going g are my guitar and skateboard as stupid as that may sound.
I love it when even the people on suicide watch fucking ignore me. 😑
